review_evidence: README explicitly states that the repository digitises mathematical definitions, theorem statements, and proofs from Scholze’s Bonn notes on solid and liquid modules.
The hydrated snapshot contains 412 Lean files and direct scan found more than 3,200 theorem/lemma/example/axiom declarations across the source tree.
Modules such as src/thm95/col_exact.lean and src/pseudo_normed_group/QprimeFP.lean contain dense checked theorem development, so this is substantive mathematical prior art.
summary: Retain lean-liquid as the Liquid Tensor Experiment formalization of Scholze/Clausen mathematics.
